root_cause.leave-announcement-blank-name: ChatBox's leave_intent row chained `structured.name ?? profileMap[pk]?.nickname ?? truncateNpub(...)`. `??` only skips null/undefined, so a cached profile with nickname '' (or whitespace) produced an empty display and the row read ' left the group'. Sibling announcements share the same `??` shape but are not part of this finding.
root_cause.backup-dirty-mark-lost: markBackupDirty before a scheduler existed stored the mark only in module-level pendingDirty; a reload in the identity-hydration window dropped it. Even with a scheduler, the mark lived only in the scheduler's timers, so a reload before the debounced publish also lost it.
root_cause.account-switch-no-notice: storage.resetAllData (the Danger Zone wipe, the account-switch path) removed lp_* keys and fired the IDB clears but posted nothing on the few-tabs channel, so other tabs kept their in-memory reaction cache, group list and chat state of the wiped account.
root_cause.share-card-signer-mismatch: encodeCard/encodeCardV2 threw a plain Error('...signer pubkey does not match...') when a NIP-46/NIP-07 signer's pubkey differed from the local identity; ShareContactCard's catch mapped EVERY failure to the generic retry-implying shareCardError.

fix.leave-announcement-blank-name: New pure helper parseStructured.resolveLeaveIntentDisplay (name -> nickname -> truncated npub, blank counts as absent via a private nonBlank trim check); ChatBox uses it. groups-leave-intent.spec: the 'USER_A sees USER_B in the member list before the leave' step now also waits (plain retrying toContainText, 60s) until Bob's name shows on his member card, before he leaves.
fix.backup-dirty-mark: New app/src/lib/backup/dirtyMark.ts (read/write/clear of localStorage few-backup-dirty = 'immediate'|'debounced', immediate sticky, all access try/catch). STORAGE_KEYS.backupDirty added so resetAllData wipes it. markBackupDirty persists on every path and bumps markSeq; publishScheduledBackup clears the mark only when publishBackup returned ok and markSeq is unchanged since the attempt began (mid-flight changes keep it; failure, connect failure and the restore-pending pause keep it); activateBackupScheduler replays in-memory OR persisted (immediate if either); the visibilitychange handler now calls markBackupDirty(true) instead of scheduler.markDirty(true) so it is persisted too. Round 1: markSeq (per tab) replaced by compare-and-clear on a fresh per-write token ('<mode>:<random>', no identity data): the publish reads the token at its start and removes the key only if unchanged, so another tab's concurrent mark survives.
fix.account-switch-notice: Round 1: storage.resetAllData is now async — removes lp_* keys, awaits the IndexedDB clears (allSettled; a rejecting clear is logged and does not stop the notice), THEN calls postAccountChanged; settings.tsx Danger Zone handler awaits it before window.location.reload() (so the reload can no longer abort the clears, and a peer cannot rehydrate the wiped account). NostrIdentityContext.replaceIdentity (mnemonic restore) posts the notice through crossTab.postAccountChangedIfSwitched when the pubkey really changed, after saveStoredIdentity. NIP-46 connect path untouched. Stale 'CURRENTLY UNUSED' comment replaced. Original: crossTab.ts AccountChangedMessage/parse/post/subscribe; crossTabReceiver.installAccountChangedReload; _app.tsx receiver; sender ignores own event via BroadcastChannel no-echo.
fix.share-card-mismatch: contactCard.SignerPubkeyMismatchError (extends Error, message unchanged so existing /signer pubkey does not match/ tests hold, prototype fixed for ES2017 target) thrown from both guards; shareCard.resolveShareCardError(err,{generic,signerMismatch}) uses instanceof; ShareContactCard uses it with copy.profile.shareCardError / new copy.profile.shareCardSignerMismatchError (en+de, exact strings from the report). No connect-time rejection.

verification_answers.VQ-1: YES. resolveLeaveIntentDisplay.test.ts: empty/whitespace/absent nickname and blank embedded name fall back to the truncated npub; 4 of 8 cases failed against the characterization helper that kept `??` (expected '' to be 'npub:ababab'), all pass after the fix. e2e AC-MEMBERS-2 waits for Bob's name with a plain retrying toContainText (no reload polling) before he leaves.
verification_answers.VQ-2: YES. backupDirtyMark.test.ts simulates reload with vi.resetModules while the fake localStorage survives: a mark raised before any scheduler is replayed (immediate flag preserved, non-immediate not invented); the key is cleared only after a successful publish and kept on publish failure, connect failure, restore-pending pause and mid-flight re-mark; a throwing/missing localStorage never throws (read returns null, mark still reaches a same-session scheduler). 9 of 13 first-version tests failed before the fix. Round 1: two-module-instance tests over one shared fake localStorage prove tab A's successful publish does not clear a mark tab B wrote mid-publish (compare-and-clear), and that a mark written before the publish began is covered and cleared.
verification_answers.VQ-3: YES (round 1). Wipe: tests prove the notice is posted only after the IDB clears finish, still posted when a clear rejects, and localStorage is gone before the clears begin; Danger Zone awaits resetAllData before reload. Mnemonic restore: postAccountChangedIfSwitched posts on a real pubkey change (also when no previous identity), stays silent for the same identity (case-insensitive); called in replaceIdentity after persistence. Receivers reload once per burst; the sender never receives its own message (echo-free bus fake). NIP-46 different-pubkey connect deliberately not covered (owner question).
verification_answers.VQ-4: YES. shareCardSignerMismatch.test.ts: both encodeCard and encodeCardV2 raise SignerPubkeyMismatchError for a foreign signer; resolveShareCardError maps it via instanceof (an ordinary Error carrying the same message text stays generic); end-to-end through getOwnShareCard with a foreign signer vs a signer that fails otherwise; en/de strings equal the report's exactly and differ from the generic copy.
verification_answers.VQ-5: YES. No publish path touched; the backup change only affects WHEN the existing self-encrypted publish runs. localStorage few-backup-dirty holds only the word immediate|debounced; the account-changed message is the bare type (test asserts no identity data and that extra fields on the wire are dropped).

retrospective.harder_than_needed: The brief's anchors had drifted (handleOpenShareCard no longer exists in settings.tsx, the wipe path is resetAllData rather than a MarmotContext clear, the leave-intent e2e name wait sits in an earlier step than the cited lines). Separately, the first e2e run died with ENFILE 'file table overflow' from next dev (system-wide, not the code) and looked like an app regression until the log was read. Round 1: the first design treated the notice as safe to send before the async IDB clear because the clear was historically fire-and-forget; the real invariant (peer reload must not see old data) forced the whole wipe async and its Danger Zone caller to await.
retrospective.surprised_by: No fast-check in this repo despite the property-test guidance, so the property-style tests are enumerated cases; and Stryker's per-line mutate ranges swept in pre-existing code (nonce regex, log strings), inflating survivors until the ranges were narrowed.
